name: lawlink
description: LawLink monorepo: Express API (backend), React web app (frontend), Expo app (mobile)

scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma generate
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
